lessons.observation: A prioritized gap is not yet an owner-executable evidence collection specification.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Dependency ordering and one exact action worked; field-level nonsecret boundaries and checklists were absent.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: The planner optimized sequencing rather than collection ergonomics.
lessons.product_change_made: Added a deterministic provider-specific first-gap evidence collection packet in JSON and text.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Required source/packet binding, expiry, digest, forbidden inputs, and closed boundaries in the packet contract and tests.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer improvements that convert owner-readable gaps into one safely executable nonsecret action.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Test field allowlists, secret-pattern rejection, deterministic digest, expiry, and owner-only routes.

lessons.observation: A canonical command manifest does not by itself prove package identities, inventories, owner receipt, and working acceptance all describe the same source state.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Per-command attribution worked; cross-receipt reconciliation still required multiple manual checks.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: Persisting a bundle with live inventory hashes would risk self-reference, so a dynamic validation boundary was needed.
lessons.product_change_made: No public product behavior changed; closed live gates were preserved.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added a dynamic non-persisted acceptance evidence bundle and check script.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: ACCEPTANCE_SUITE_MANIFEST_V1.7.82.json, WORKING_TREE_ACCEPTANCE_V1.7.82.json, and V14 receipt automation
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer dynamic cross-binding when persisted evidence would become circular.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Reject missing/duplicate/reordered commands, hash drift, inventory drift, stale source/packet identity, and embedded final ZIP identity.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact GitHub repository and Render service are canonical?
Which external nonsecret receipt should be collected first after those identities are known?
next_version_learning_priorities: Audited evidence application authorization after exact live receipts
